name: camayoc_ex_blocked_by_chain
description: The whole chain of what a work item waits on, transitively through aegis:blockedOn, with each link's closedAt when it has one. Answers 'why can this not start' in one call rather than one hop at a time.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?blocker ?label ?closedAt WHERE { <{item}> aegis:blockedOn+ ?blocker . ?blocker rdfs:label ?label . OPTIONAL { ?blocker aegis:closedAt ?closedAt } } ORDER BY ?label

params.name: item
params.description: The work item whose blockers to trace
